description: A disease caused by a severe vitamin C deficiency.
causes: Lack of vitamin C in the diet.
prevention: Eat a diet rich in vitamin C (fruits and vegetables).
treatment_action: Vitamin C supplements and dietary changes.
complications: Severe jaundice, generalized edema, and spontaneous bleeding.

description: Occurs when the blood supply to part of your brain is interrupted or reduced.
causes: Blocked artery (ischemic stroke) or leaking/bursting of a blood vessel (hemorrhagic stroke).
symptoms: Paralysis or numbness of the face, arm or leg
prevention: Control high blood pressure, quit smoking, and exercise regularly.
treatment_action: Emergency medical care is crucial. Treatments include clot-busting drugs or surgery.
complications: Paralysis, memory loss, and emotional problems.
